conventions.budgets: Words remaining; nearest integer with halves upward
conventions.characters: Unicode code points, including whitespace; no normalization
conventions.input_sha256: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no whitespace, and unescaped Unicode
conventions.letters: Unicode str.isalpha(); combining marks are not letters
conventions.occurrences: Case-sensitive literal matches; nonoverlapping by default
conventions.text_sha256: Exact UTF-8 string bytes; no normalization
conventions.words: Whitespace-separated units; omit whole backtick/tilde fence lines with optional info text, tokens made only of `*_~#>+-, and numeric list-marker tokens such as 1. or 1).
